name: shva
description: Shiva Kakkar's personal Claude Code plugins. Cross-cutting tools that aren't tied to any single product — vocabulary briefings, prompt scaffolds, LinkedIn authoring with Shiva's voice, and personal workflow accelerators.

plugins.name: shva
plugins.description: Personal command + skill pack. v0.1.0 shipped /shva:brief-me — a domain-agnostic pre-project vocabulary briefing that returns a 20-25 term glossary (Creative/Style · Technical/Process · Prompt/Direction) before any GenAI build (code, design, video, music, art); forces vocabulary alignment between user and AI before instructions are given, reducing drift and hallucination; ships with the 'flag terms I'm using incorrectly' coda that turns Claude into a real-time vocabulary coach. v0.3.0 adds /shva:shva-linkedin-post-writer — write LinkedIn posts in Dr. Shiva Kakkar's distinctive systems-thinker voice using three signature lenses (Sequence Inversion, Constraint Migration, Authority Redesign), six-tier MCP source hierarchy (his Readwise/Voicenotes/Plaud/Gemini-files/LlamaCloud first, web as support last), Hook Test + Cringe Test gates, kostja mechanics clash table, and a god-mode pipeline that handles post + visual + LinkedIn publish protocol + self-learning JSONL loop + Wiki Save + Taste Capture into the Obsidian LLM wiki. v0.4.0 adds the Medium duo: /shva:shva-medium-writer drafts a 1500-2000 word Medium-grade essay in Shiva's voice for shivakakkar.com (7-beat long-form template, Astro frontmatter, SEO/AI-SEO co-citation rules — ≥3 tier-1 institutional names co-located with Rehearsal/Gradeless, ≥5 quotable standalone sentences, v1.0 bio footer); /shva:shva-medium-poster publishes the deployed essay to Medium under 'Built at Rehearsal' via Chrome automation (state machine over import → cleanup → tags → submit-for-review, cache-staleness sentinel detection, full failure-recovery playbook from the 4-essay 2026-05-12 session).
